scope: Verify application of the published TemplateFlow MNI152NLin6Asym and MNI152NLin2009cAsym H5 pair. This is not qualification of a neuroatlas-built registration or independent re-establishment of anatomical accuracy.
scalar_error_bound: Euclidean norm of maximum physical per-axis source intensity gradients times 0.001 mm, plus 0.000001 for floating point storage. Compared on the source interpolation interior; all-grid and boundary discrepancies are retained separately.
visual_review: Both directions on both grids; pinned evidence receipts required.
label_overlap_interpretation: Harvard-Oxford labels in the target template were mapped upstream. Their overlap is concordance, not independent anatomical ground truth.
